results.BEAT_EXPLAIN: Measured only while a beat reference reaches you - music on, or the beat pulse in your hand (a soft tick on hand tracking). Beat lock is the phase consistency of your detected footstrikes against the music grid: 100 means every strike lands at the same point in the beat. Strikes come from your head bob, which lags the true footstep by a roughly constant offset - the lock ignores any constant offset and your average offset is never read as timing accuracy. Grid: every beat, every 2nd beat, or every half beat - chosen from your own cadence.
results.BEAT_SETTING_TIP: The controllers pulse on the music grid - through the countdown, and through the walk when set to WALK. Hand tracking has no haptics: a soft tick plays instead (muted when music is muted). Pulses landing within 60 ms after a countdown tick are skipped so the two never double-hit; GO stays on the grid. Walk pulses are stamped on the walk record as the delivered beat reference.
